title: Astra Otoparts
bottom_line: Astra International owns 80% of Astra Otoparts, and Astra's own vehicle makers are its biggest buyers: Astra Honda Motor took Rp4.47T (22%) of 2025 sales and Astra Daihatsu 6%, figures confirmed in audited accounts. The machining side has three in-house units (WINTEQ builds special machines and automation lines, EDC makes dies and moulds, Nusametal die-casts aluminium) plus part-owned firms that cast, forge and machine engine and drivetrain parts, such as IGP (42.5%), AT Indonesia (40%), Federal Nittan (40%), MetalArt Astra (30%) and Federal Izumi (58%). Most joint-venture stakes, product lists and buyer awards are the company's own claims, and the TKDN register confirms a 47.72% local-content VMC-930E CNC mill in Astra Otoparts' name but does not say which unit builds it. Small suppliers come in through Astra's foundation YDBA (2,030 coached firms that sold Rp4.9T to Astra Group in 2025); named examples here are Kannindo in Tegal (washers for Kayaba) and Arkha in Purwakarta (painting for Astra Komponen).

entities.name: Astra Otoparts
entities.what: Listed (IDX: AUTO) auto-parts maker and trader, 80% owned by Astra International: 55 companies (6 own units, 14 consolidated subsidiaries, 20 JVs and associates, 15 indirect holdings); 2025 revenue Rp19.9T, profit Rp2.35T; holds the TKDN entry for the VMC-930E CNC mill (47.72%).

entities.name: Astra International
entities.what: Parent: holds 80.00% of Astra Otoparts (31 Dec 2025 and 30 Jun 2026). Its largest shareholder is Jardine Cycle & Carriage, part of Jardine Matheson. Also the group behind AHM, ADM, TAM and the YDBA foundation.

entities.name: WINTEQ (Workshop for Industrial Equipment)
entities.legal_name: PT Astra Otoparts Tbk - Winteq Division
entities.city: Cibinong, Kab. Bogor (AR 2025 address); a Sep 2026 Bisnis snippet says Karawang
entities.what: Astra Otoparts' machine-building division since 2006: special-purpose machines, automation and robotics, MES and other Industry 4.0 systems, and technical training, for group plants and outside customers; earlier machine exports to Thailand and Vietnam; machining and casting lines to AOP Philippines in Sep 2026.

entities.name: Astra Otoparts EDC (Engineering Development Center)
entities.legal_name: PT Astra Otoparts Tbk - Engineering Development Center Division
entities.city: Cikarang Pusat, Kab. Bekasi (GIIC, Kota Deltamas)
entities.what: R&D division since 2012: product design, testing and validation, CAE simulation, and dies and moulds for group companies; listed by IMDIA as a mould-and-die maker. Executive in charge in 2025: Aji Atmojo.

entities.name: Nusametal
entities.legal_name: PT Astra Otoparts Tbk - Nusametal Division
entities.what: Aluminium die-casting division (company site: established 1990); 2025 supplier awards from TMMIN, Hino and AHM.

entities.name: VMC-930E CNC milling machine
entities.what: CNC vertical milling machine registered to PT Astra Otoparts Tbk at 47.72% local content: X/Y/Z travel 700/400/500 mm, 900 x 400 mm table, BT40 spindle, 5.5 kW, up to 6,000 rpm. The register shows only the head-office address; no source names the unit that builds it.

entities.name: Menara Terus Makmur (MTM)
entities.what: 100% subsidiary: forged mechanical jacks, hand tools and machined components for the auto industry (commercial operation 1989); technical partners Kawasaki Industrial Co. and MetalArt Corp. of Japan.

entities.name: Astra Daido Steel Indonesia (ADSI)
entities.city: Cikarang Pusat, Kab. Bekasi (also Sidoarjo and Kota Tangerang)
entities.what: 66.67% subsidiary with Daido Steel (Japan), operating since 1994: tool-steel supply and cutting, machined plates and heat treatment (TD surface hardening up to 3,300 HV).

entities.name: Federal Izumi Manufacturing (FIM)
entities.what: 58.06% subsidiary making pistons by gravity casting and forging (since 1992); technical partner MAHLE Engine Component Japan; 2025 'Machining Part' award from Yanmar Diesel Indonesia and awards from Kubota and Isuzu.

entities.name: Nusa Keihin Indonesia (NKI)
entities.what: 51% subsidiary making transmission-control and other vehicle transmission components (since 1998), with design and process support from Keihin Seimitsu Kogyo (Japan); 2025 awards from ADM and Hino.

entities.name: Pakoakuina
entities.what: 51% subsidiary making wheel rims (since 1988), the biggest AOP subsidiary by assets (Rp2.42T); technical partner Topy Industries (Japan); owns PT Palingda Nasional and PT Inkoasku.

entities.name: Velasto Indonesia
entities.what: 100% subsidiary: moulded rubber parts and hoses, plus Wintor plantation transporters and mini tractors designed and built in Cikarang (1,177 Wintor units Nov 2013 to Jul 2017; 86% local content claimed).

entities.name: Astra Komponen Indonesia (ASKI)
entities.what: 100% subsidiary (since 2011): plastic injection, painting, mirrors and seats for motorcycles, cars and trucks; a tier-1 supplier to AHM; technical partner Magna International Japan.

entities.name: Astra Otoparts Philippines (AOPP)
entities.what: 100% subsidiary set up 6 Jan 2025 to make and trade components; first shipments of two-wheeler engine parts and frames to Honda Philippines in Jan 2026; took WINTEQ machining and casting lines in Sep 2026.

entities.name: Inti Ganda Perdana (IGP)
entities.what: 42.5% JV (since 1982) making drivetrain parts for cars, pick-ups, trucks and buses (rear axles and propeller shafts per a 2016 profile; AOP groups it with differential carrier work); 2025 revenue Rp3.89T; holds 26.2% of Asano Gear Indonesia and 51% of Astra NTN Driveshaft.

entities.name: Asano Gear Indonesia
entities.what: Gear maker, 26.2% held by IGP alongside Japan's Asano Gear Co.; 2025 Best Supplier and Best Cost awards from Daihatsu Drivetrain Manufacturing Indonesia.

entities.name: Astra NTN Driveshaft Indonesia (ANDI)
entities.what: Drive-shaft (constant-velocity joint) maker, 51% held by IGP with NTN Corporation (Japan); 2025 awards from TMMIN and Honda Prospect Motor.

entities.name: Akashi Wahana Indonesia (AWI)
entities.what: Transmission maker for the Daihatsu group (snippets: set up Apr 2006 to support ADM; transmissions and steering gears); 35% held by PT Wahana Eka Paramitra, in which AOP holds 43.5%; partner Akashi Kikai Seisakusho.

entities.name: AT Indonesia (ATI)
entities.what: 40% JV with Aisin Takaoka (est. 14 May 1996): grey and ductile iron castings plus machining (1.2 million pcs/month), metal forming and painting; exhaust manifolds, brake drums, caliper bodies, hubs, differential cases.

entities.name: Federal Nittan Industries (FNI)
entities.what: 40% JV with Nittan Valve (now NITTAN Corp.) making engine valves (set up Jun 1995 per MarkLines, snippet); 2025 awards from TMMIN, Hino, Suzuki and the Yamaha group.

entities.name: MetalArt Astra Indonesia
entities.what: 30% JV with MetalArt Corporation (Japan), est. 2013: forged and machined precision gears, crankshafts and connecting rods for auto and non-auto use; 2025 awards from TMMIN, ADM and Honda Prospect Motor.

entities.name: Kayaba Indonesia (KYB)
entities.what: 50% JV with KYB (Kayaba) Corp. making shock absorbers on precision lines (since 1976); 2025 revenue Rp3.55T; buys washers from YDBA-coached Tegal shop Kannindo.

entities.name: Aisin Indonesia
entities.what: 34% held through AOP's trading arm PT Senantiasa Makmur, with Aisin: door frames, locks and hinges, clutch covers and discs, oil and water pumps, resin intake manifolds; owns Aisin Indonesia Automotive and 30% of Advics Manufacturing Indonesia.

entities.name: Denso Indonesia
entities.city: Cikarang Barat, Kab. Bekasi (MM2100); Sunter, Jakarta
entities.what: 25.66% associate with the Denso group (since 1975) and AOP's largest associate: 2025 revenue Rp18.7T, profit Rp1.26T. AOP sources do not list its products; it sits in AOP's Manufacturing V portfolio (compressors, car air-con, speedometers, lamps, gaskets).

entities.name: Astra Honda Motor (AHM)
entities.what: Astra-group motorcycle maker and AOP's biggest customer: Rp4.47T in 2025, 22.43% of AOP revenue; runs IKM supplier-development programmes with YDBA.

entities.name: Astra Daihatsu Motor (ADM)
entities.what: Astra-group carmaker (Daihatsu): bought Rp1.24T from AOP in 2025, 6.21% of revenue; 2025 supplier awards to AT Indonesia, MetalArt, Akashi Wahana, Nusa Keihin, IGP and Kayaba.

entities.name: Toyota Astra Motor (TAM)
entities.what: Astra group's Toyota sales company: bought Rp29.6bn from AOP in 2025 (0.15% of revenue). Toyota's factory company TMMIN is the bigger buyer of machined parts.

entities.name: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Indonesia (TMMIN)
entities.what: Toyota's Indonesian car-making company; not an AOP related party, but gave 2025 supplier awards to IGP, AT Indonesia, MetalArt, Federal Nittan, Astra NTN Driveshaft, Pakoakuina, Kayaba and Nusametal.

entities.name: Honda Philippines
entities.what: Motorcycle maker; took first deliveries of two-wheeler engine components and frames from AOP Philippines and Astra Visteon Philippines in Jan 2026.

entities.name: AOP aftermarket network (Domestic, International, Shop&Drive)
entities.legal_name: PT Astra Otoparts Tbk trading units; PT Ardendi Jaya Sentosa; PT Senantiasa Makmur
entities.what: AOP's own replacement-parts channel: 52 main dealers outside Java and Bali, sales offices and about 12,000 retailers; Shop&Drive, Shop&Bike and Motoquick outlets; exports to 40+ countries (site) or 50+ (SR 2025).

entities.name: Yayasan Astra - YDBA
entities.what: Astra International's small-business coaching foundation, founded 2 May 1980 by William Soeryadjaya: 2,030 active coached firms in 21 regions; Astra Group bought Rp4.9T from them in 2025; in Kab. Tegal about 70 coached metal shops, 16 with supply deals, work as tier-2 for AHM, TAM, ADM and Suzuki (2024).

entities.name: Kemenperin (Ministry of Industry)
entities.what: Keeps the TKDN local-content register (VMC-930E at 47.72%) and runs the small-industry 'link and match' MoUs with YDBA, AHM and AOP (60 MoUs, 57 IKM in Dec 2024).

entities.name: Politeknik Astra (ASTRAtech)
entities.what: Astra's polytechnic; built the Innostra 3-in-1 CNC (milling, laser engraving, 3D printing) with WINTEQ, released 26 Jul 2023; claims 43% local content and a price about 20% lower (no TKDN register entry found).

entities.name: Kannindo Metal Industri
entities.what: Tegal metal shop coached by YDBA through LPB Tegal; shown in Dec 2023 with washers to be supplied to PT Kayaba Indonesia. Commissioner: Harjono.

entities.name: Arkha Industries Indonesia
entities.what: Small manufacturer coached by YDBA since 2022 that paints plastic motorcycle parts; supplies Astra Komponen Indonesia (called tier-1 to ASKI in Bisnis, snippet). Owner Mad Ali Haris; operations director Bagus Setiawan.

entities.name: Kawani Tekno Nusantara
entities.what: Job-order manufacturing and fabrication shop, a YDBA partner since the 1990s; UMKM Mandiri (2024) and ISO-certified; final evaluation for Astra Group supplier status due Nov 2026. Director Yadi Nugraha.

entities.name: Hamdani Dzulkarnaen Salim
entities.what: AOP President Director from 2013 until he resigned at the 17 Apr 2026 AGM, overseeing WINTEQ and EDC; at 31 Dec 2025 also a Director of Astra International, chairman of GIAMM, and president commissioner of Aisin Indonesia, Denso Indonesia, AT Indonesia, Akebono, GS Battery and Fuji Technica Indonesia; ex-AHM production director.

entities.name: Yusak Kristian Solaeman
entities.what: AOP President Director since 17 Apr 2026 (Vice President Director before); president commissioner of Kayaba Indonesia and vice president commissioner of Pakoakuina; earlier president director of Isuzu Astra Motor Indonesia (2023-2025).

entities.name: Thomas Junaidi Alim Wijaya
entities.what: AOP President Commissioner since 17 Apr 2026; at 31 Dec 2025 Vice President Director of AHM and a Director of Astra International; AHM marketing director 2017-2023.

entities.name: Gidion Hasan
entities.what: AOP President Commissioner from 2019 to 17 Apr 2026, then Commissioner; at 31 Dec 2025 a Director of Astra International, vice president commissioner of ADM and president commissioner of Fuji Technica Indonesia; ex-president director of United Tractors.

entities.name: Ronny Kusgianta
entities.what: AOP Director for Manufacturing I (chassis frames, rear axles, drive shafts, differentials, transmissions); president director of IGP, Gemala Kempa Daya and Wahana Eka Paramitra; commissioner across Akashi Wahana, Asano Gear, Astra NTN Driveshaft and AT Indonesia (31 Dec 2025).

entities.name: Andi Gunanto
entities.what: AOP Director for Manufacturing III and executive in charge of Nusametal (its former COO); president commissioner of Menara Terus Makmur, MetalArt Astra and Astra Komponen; president director of Nusa Keihin (31 Dec 2025); ex-Aisin Indonesia engineering head.

entities.name: Tujuh Martogi Siahaan
entities.what: AOP Director for Manufacturing IV (materials and heat treatment, pistons) and aftermarket and trading; president commissioner of Astra Daido Steel and Federal Izumi; president director of trading arms Ardendi Jaya Sentosa and Senantiasa Makmur (31 Dec 2025).

entities.name: Prihatanto Agung Lesmono
entities.what: AOP Director for Manufacturing V and business development; president director of Astra Komponen Indonesia, chairman of AOP Philippines, commissioner of Denso Indonesia (31 Dec 2025); ex-president director of Astra Visteon Indonesia (2015-2024).

entities.name: Fadli Hari Purnomo
entities.what: Head of WINTEQ: executive in charge in the AR 2025 org chart, quoted as WINTEQ Chief Operating Officer on the Philippine export (Sep 2026).

entities.name: Rahmat Samulo
entities.what: Chair (Ketua Pengurus) of Yayasan Astra-YDBA in reports from Sep 2024 to Aug 2026; the chair in 2022-2023 was Sigit P. Kumala.
